verse_renderings.text: So then, just as you received Christ Jesus as Lord, continue to live your lives in him.
You are already rooted in him. Now keep building your life on him, growing stronger in the faith you were taught, and overflowing with gratitude.
Be careful that no one leads you away captive through empty, deceptive philosophy that is based on human tradition and on the elemental principles that govern this world, rather than on Christ.
For the entire fullness of God lives in Christ in bodily form,
and you have been brought to fullness in him. He is the head over every ruler and authority.
In union with him you were also circumcised—not a circumcision performed by human hands, but the circumcision that Christ himself brings about, stripping off the fleshly body.
You were buried with him in baptism, and in that same baptism you were raised with him, through faith in the working of God, who raised him from the dead.
You were dead because of your sins and because your flesh was uncircumcised—but God made you alive together with Christ. He forgave us all our sins.
He erased the record of debt that stood against us—the decrees that condemned us—and took it out of the way, nailing it to the cross.
He disarmed the rulers and authorities, made a public spectacle of them, and triumphed over them through the cross.

verse_renderings.text: So, just as you received Christ Jesus as Lord, continue to live in union with him.
You have been firmly rooted in him; now keep being built up in him and strengthened in the faith you were taught, overflowing with gratitude.
Be careful that no one captures you with a philosophy that is empty and deceptive. Such teaching follows human traditions and the elemental principles that govern this world rather than Christ.
For all the fullness of God lives in Christ in bodily form.
And because you are united with Christ, you have been brought to fullness. He is the head over every ruler and authority.
In union with Christ, you were also circumcised, but not by human hands. In this circumcision performed by Christ, your fleshly body was stripped off.
When you were baptized, you were buried with Christ. You were also raised with him through your faith in God's powerful work, for God raised Christ from the dead.
You were dead in your wrongdoings, with your flesh still uncircumcised. But God made you alive with Christ and forgave us all our wrongdoings.
He erased the written record of debt that stood against us with its binding decrees. He removed it from our midst by nailing it to the cross.
God stripped the rulers and authorities of their power and displayed them publicly as defeated enemies, triumphing over them through the cross.

output.paragraph_rendering:
So, just as you received Christ Jesus as Lord, continue to live in union with him. You have been firmly rooted in him; now keep being built up in him and strengthened in the faith you were taught, overflowing with gratitude.

Be careful that no one captures you with a philosophy that is empty and deceptive. Such teaching follows human traditions and the elemental principles that govern this world rather than Christ. For all the fullness of God lives in Christ in bodily form. And because you are united with Christ, you have been brought to fullness. He is the head over every ruler and authority.

In union with Christ, you were also circumcised, but not by human hands. In this circumcision performed by Christ, your fleshly body was stripped off. When you were baptized, you were buried with Christ. You were also raised with him through your faith in God's powerful work, for God raised Christ from the dead.

You were dead in your wrongdoings, with your flesh still uncircumcised. But God made you alive with Christ and forgave us all our wrongdoings. He erased the written record of debt that stood against us with its binding decrees. He removed it from our midst by nailing it to the cross. God stripped the rulers and authorities of their power and displayed them publicly as defeated enemies, triumphing over them through the cross.

verse_renderings.text: So then, just as you received Christ Jesus as Lord, continue to live your lives in him.
You are already firmly rooted in him, and now you are being built up and strengthened in the faith you were taught, overflowing with thankfulness.

Be careful that no one takes you captive through empty, deceptive teaching that passes as philosophy, relying on human tradition and the elemental principles that govern this world, rather than on Christ.
For all the divine fullness dwells bodily in Christ.
And you already stand completely filled in him, who is the head over every ruler and authority.
In him you were also circumcised—not with a physical procedure done by human hands, but by stripping off the fleshly body through the circumcision accomplished by Christ.
You were buried with him in baptism, and you were also raised with him through faith in the working of God, who raised Christ from the dead.
Even when you were dead in your transgressions and the uncircumcision of your flesh, God made you alive with Christ. He forgave all our transgressions,
erasing the written record of obligation with its decrees that stood against us. He removed it completely by nailing it to the cross.
In this way, God disarmed the rulers and authorities and exposed them to public disgrace, triumphing over them through the cross.
